raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer first assumed Ensembl release 102 (November 2020) would satisfy the “as of 20/10/2020” constraint, failing to respect the temporal requirement. This led the search down the wrong archive and culminated in providing a link to release-102 rather than the correct release available on 20/10/2020 (likely release-101).
